description: Deploy a MyMultiSig wallet from the official factory (the agent key pays gas) and register it on mymultisig.app. Needs MYMULTISIG_PRIVATE_KEY. Refuses a wallet the agent could operate alone (agent is an owner and threshold is 1). Confirm owners, threshold and chain with the user first.

chainId.description: EVM chain id, e.g. 11155111 for Sepolia (see list_networks)

factory.description: Defaults to the official factory on the chain

onlyOwnerRequest.description: Extended/advanced only: only owners may queue requests

salt.description: bytes32 salt for a deterministic (CREATE2) address on 0.5.0 factories

walletType.description: simple = MyMultiSig; extended/advanced = MyMultiSigExtended (owner-only requests, ERC-4337, …)

name: create_multisig
title: Deploy a new multisig
